Basis.description: What dependency evidence says about a dependency (spec §14.1).
Basis.title: Basis

BufferPolicy.description: Explicit plan buffer, shown separately from estimates (spec §49.2).
BufferPolicy.title: BufferPolicy

CapabilityFact.description: Whether a service, feature or option exists in a Region (REGION-SVC-001).
CapabilityFact.title: CapabilityFact

CloudFrontOriginGroup.description: Origin failover: CloudFront retries the secondary on the listed status codes.
CloudFrontOriginGroup.title: CloudFrontOriginGroup

CodePipelineProperties.description: A delivery pipeline. Out of RTO scope by default (spec §24.1).
CodePipelineProperties.title: CodePipelineProperties

DRStrategy.description: Stack-level strategy families (spec §27). Each maps to per-service mechanisms.
DRStrategy.title: DRStrategy

DependencyEdge.description: One typed edge between two resources. Parallel edges are kept (spec §19.1).
DependencyEdge.title: DependencyEdge

DependencyGroup.description:
Alternatives among a dependent's edges (spec §19.1).

An ungrouped required edge is an ALL requirement. Checks that need the graph
(members share the dependent and scope, an edge is in at most one group) run
when the graph is built.
DependencyGroup.title: DependencyGroup

DrPosture.description: Declared posture of an external dependency (spec §15.2).
DrPosture.title: DrPosture

DurationEstimate.description:
A duration range without fake statistical precision (spec §49).

A None bound means that bound is unknown; it is never treated as zero.
DurationEstimate.title: DurationEstimate

DynamoDBBackupProperties.description: An on-demand or AWS Backup backup of a table.
DynamoDBBackupProperties.title: DynamoDBBackupProperties

DynamoDBReplica.description: A Global Tables replica in another Region.
DynamoDBReplica.title: DynamoDBReplica

ECRImageProperties.description:
One image in one Region. An image referenced by digest must exist in the DR
Region's registry for a task or pod to start there.
ECRImageProperties.title: ECRImageProperties

ECRRegistryProperties.description:
The account's registry in one Region. Replication is configured here, once per
registry, not per repository, so a PR touching it may conflict with other owners.
ECRRegistryProperties.title: ECRRegistryProperties

ExternalResourceProperties.description: A dependency outside AWS discovery. Valid only on nodes with provider "external".
ExternalResourceProperties.title: ExternalResourceProperties

GenericResourceProperties.description: Fallback for an AWS resource type with no typed model. Not allowed when one exists.
GenericResourceProperties.title: GenericResourceProperties

IAMPolicyProperties.description: A customer-managed policy: the statements of its default version.
IAMPolicyProperties.title: IAMPolicyProperties

IdentityCenterInstanceProperties.description: An IAM Identity Center instance: where operators sign in.
IdentityCenterInstanceProperties.title: IdentityCenterInstanceProperties

InstanceTypeOfferingFact.description: Which instance types a Region or Availability Zone offers.
InstanceTypeOfferingFact.title: InstanceTypeOfferingFact

KMSKeyProperties.description:
A KMS key. Keys are Regional: data encrypted with a single-Region key can't
be decrypted in the DR Region (XREG-KMS-003). Multi-Region keys share key
material across Regions.
KMSKeyProperties.title: KMSKeyProperties

LambdaEventSourceMappingProperties.description: A poller that reads a queue or stream and invokes a function (SQS, DynamoDB, Kinesis).
LambdaEventSourceMappingProperties.title: LambdaEventSourceMappingProperties

LogGroupProperties.description: Out of RTO scope by default (spec §24.1) but assessed under Observability.
LogGroupProperties.title: LogGroupProperties

MetricFact.description: A CloudWatch metric series over a window, e.g. replica lag for RPO (spec §51).
MetricFact.title: MetricFact

PolicyStatement.description:
One IAM policy statement, structured so rules can check resource ARNs.

Rules use it to find a DR role whose policy grants only primary-Region ARNs
(XREG-IAM-002). Statements with Resource "*" are kept but carry no weight as
dependency evidence (spec §22).
PolicyStatement.title: PolicyStatement

QuotaFact.description: A Service Quotas limit, with current usage when it could be measured.
QuotaFact.title: QuotaFact

RDSInstanceProperties.description: A DB instance: standalone (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB) or a member of an Aurora cluster.
RDSInstanceProperties.title: RDSInstanceProperties

RDSSnapshotProperties.description:
A DB snapshot (`rds/snapshot`) or cluster snapshot (`rds/cluster-snapshot`).

A restore in the DR Region needs a snapshot that is *in* the DR Region (copied
there) and encrypted with a key usable there.
RDSSnapshotProperties.title: RDSSnapshotProperties

ReadinessCheckProperties.description: Legacy ARC readiness check: collected when present, never recommended.
ReadinessCheckProperties.title: ReadinessCheckProperties

RecoveryRequirement.description: What a stack must achieve for one failure scope.
RecoveryRequirement.title: RecoveryRequirement

RelationshipType.description: Initial relationship vocabulary (spec §20). Add types only when they are useful.
RelationshipType.title: RelationshipType

ResourceNode.description: One resource from any source, merged by identity resolution (spec §15.1).
ResourceNode.title: ResourceNode

RoutingControlProperties.description: An ARC routing control: an on/off switch that health checks follow (data plane).
RoutingControlProperties.title: RoutingControlProperties

RtoScope.description: Whether a stack resource is on its recovery path (spec §24.1).
RtoScope.title: RtoScope

SSMParameterProperties.description:
SSM parameter metadata. The value is never stored. SSM has no cross-Region
replication, so DR copies come from a prerequisite script (spec §63.1).
SSMParameterProperties.title: SSMParameterProperties

ScanCoverage.description: What one collection run checked, for one account, scope, service and operation family.
ScanCoverage.title: ScanCoverage

SecretProperties.description: Secrets Manager metadata. The value is never read (GetSecretValue is never called).
SecretProperties.title: SecretProperties

SecretReference.description: A secret injected into a container: the reference, never the value (spec §67).
SecretReference.title: SecretReference

ServiceAutoScaling.description: Application Auto Scaling bounds registered for the service.
ServiceAutoScaling.title: ServiceAutoScaling

ServiceLoadBalancer.description: A target group the service registers tasks with.
ServiceLoadBalancer.title: ServiceLoadBalancer

SourceReference.description:
Where a resource was seen. The spec uses this type without defining it.

`locator` identifies the record in its source, for example a Terraform address
qualified by root and workspace, or an AWS API operation and identifier.
SourceReference.title: SourceReference

SourceType.description: Where a piece of evidence came from.
SourceType.title: SourceType

Stack.description:
Everything one product needs to serve its users.

The DR target Region and account live only on RecoveryRequirement, never here.
Stack.title: Stack

StackResource.description: Stack membership with its RTO scope. Membership is many-to-many.
StackResource.title: StackResource

StackService.description:
A service inside a stack, e.g. "checkout-api".

Holds its compute plus the resources only it uses. Shared resources such as
the VPC or a shared database belong to the stack directly.
StackService.title: StackService
